name: reproduce the input schema into the output csv
definition: Write the refined masks back into a CSV that keeps the same row count and column names, embedding coordinate lists as list-valued fields so the output columns resolve as flat numeric lists when read.

name: return structured not-found errors for invalid identifiers
definition: make unknown block hashes and transaction ids return a not-found status with a single error field in the JSON body.
failure_mode: a non-404 status or a missing error key fails.
